subject: Next steps: Private/VPC architecture review
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>; Samir Rao <srao@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Private/VPC architecture review

Hi Alex / Samir —

Thanks again for the discovery call today. Appreciate the overview of Acme Health's use case and the constraints you mentioned around PHI handling and network isolation. Next logical step from our side is a 60-minute technical deep dive / architecture review focused on the Private (VPC) deployment path so we can: 

- Walk through Redwood Private network architecture and peering options (VPC peering, PrivateLink, VPN)
- Discuss KMS/HSM key management and encryption in transit/at rest
- Review onboarding pre-reqs (IAM, routes, security groups, proxy requirements)
- Surface any compliance evidence you want ahead of procurement (SOC 2, audit logs)

Suggested slots (PDT):
- Tue Jul 27 10:00–11:00
- Wed Jul 28 14:00–15:00
- Thu Jul 29 09:00–10:00

If none of those work, send a couple windows that do and we’ll align. I’ve attached a short architecture deck and a pre-meeting checklist to help prep.

Attaching: redwood-private-architecture-deck.pdf (deck), redwood-vpc-prereqs.pdf (pre-req checklist)

Thanks — I’ll loop in Dylan (SE) and Dev (solutions architect) to join the deep-dive.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <srao@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Private/VPC architecture review

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the materials. Good summary. We’re definitely interested in the VPC private deployment path. A couple quick questions before we lock time: 

1) For KMS, do you support customer-managed keys (CMK) via a cloud KMS (AWS KMS) or an HSM? We need to ensure keys never leave our control.
2) Is VPC peering the recommended route for Acme’s setup if we want low latency, or should we consider PrivateLink to reduce cross-account route complexity?
3) Can you share a SOC 2 summary or evidence we can provide to procurement ahead of contract review?

For times, Wed Jul 28 14:00 PDT works for our team. I'll invite Samir (infra) + myself + our procurement lead (I'll add them once we confirm).

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering | Acme Health
alex.johnson@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Private/VPC architecture review

Perfect — Wed Jul 28 14:00 PDT is locked on our side.

Quick answers: 
- KMS: Yes, we support customer-managed keys with AWS KMS and can support HSM-backed keys for Private deployments; we’ll have Dylan cover the exact flow and key rotation model in the deep-dive.
- VPC peering vs PrivateLink: both are viable; peering gives direct routes but requires cross-account routes, PrivateLink reduces networking configuration and surface area. We’ll present recommended patterns and tradeoffs.
- SOC 2: attaching our SOC2-summary.pdf for procurement review. If you need more formal evidence we can provide an NDA/secure artifact exchange path.

Dylan / Dev — can you please own the technical agenda and send the calendar invite? We anticipate 60 minutes and the agenda above. HubSpot deal: RD-2027-0117.

Marissa

Alex / Samir —

Thanks — invite sent for Wed Jul 28 14:00–15:00 PDT (Google Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234). Please confirm attendee emails so I can ensure the conferencing details work for everyone.

Pre-meeting asks to make the session productive: 
- Share preferred cloud account IDs (AWS) and whether you prefer VPC peering or PrivateLink (or open to recommendations)
- Any firewall/proxy that blocks outbound ports (we need to know for egress rules)
- Confirm whether you require KMS CMK (we’ll show the flow)
- Preferred IaC artifacts: Terraform / CloudFormation / Pulumi? If you can drop a small Terraform snippet or the VPC CIDRs into the invite notes that’ll speed things up.

Attaching: redwood-vpc-prereqs.pdf (short checklist).

I’ll run through the network diagrams and demo the Private control plane deployment steps. Looking forward to it.

—Dylan
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samir Rao <srao@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Private/VPC architecture review — calendar invite + pre-reqs

Dylan —

Thanks, invite received and confirmed. Attendees from Acme: Alex Johnson (platform), Samir Rao (infra), Priya Sen (procurement). We prefer VPC peering for low latency but are open to the PrivateLink tradeoffs — we'll let you recommend during the session. We do require AWS KMS CMKs (customer-managed), and we will drop our account IDs in the calendar notes. Procurement asked for the SOC doc — I see SOC2-summary.pdf attached, that should do for an initial review.

See you Wed Jul 28 14:00 PDT.

Alex
